slides.title: Cover
slides.transcript: [warmly] Now, the colours. <break time="0.4s" /> Nine bright animals, and nine new colours to learn. <break time="0.5s" /> [warmly] Here we go.

slides.title: Red
slides.transcript: [warmly] Red. <break time="0.4s" /> A little ladybug, round and red. Spot! Spot! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Spot, spot, spot!

slides.title: Yellow
slides.transcript: [warmly] Yellow. <break time="0.4s" /> A soft yellow duckling. Peep! Peep! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Peep peep peep!

slides.title: Blue
slides.transcript: [warmly] Blue. <break time="0.4s" /> A big blue whale, in the deep blue sea. Splaaaash! <break time="0.5s" /> [excited] Sploooosh!

slides.title: Green
slides.transcript: [warmly] Green. <break time="0.4s" /> A little green frog, sitting on a leaf. Ribbit! Ribbit! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Ribbit ribbit!

slides.title: Orange
slides.transcript: [warmly] Orange. <break time="0.4s" /> An orange tiger, with black stripes. Rrrroooaaar! <break time="0.5s" /> [excited] Rrrroooaaar!

slides.title: Purple
slides.transcript: [warmly] Purple. <break time="0.4s" /> A purple butterfly, up and away. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] Flutter, flutter, flutter away!

slides.title: Pink
slides.transcript: [warmly] Pink. <break time="0.4s" /> A tall pink flamingo, standing on one leg. Honk! Honk! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Honk honk honk!

slides.title: Brown
slides.transcript: [warmly] Brown. <break time="0.4s" /> A big brown bear, sleepy and slow. Grrrrrr... grrrrumble... <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] grrrr!

slides.title: Grey
slides.transcript: [warmly] Grey. <break time="0.4s" /> A soft grey cat, curled up and sleepy. Purr... <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] purr...

slides.title: White
slides.transcript: [warmly] White. <break time="0.4s" /> A white dove, up on the roof. Coo! Coo! <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Coo… coo…

slides.title: Black
slides.transcript: [warmly] Black. <break time="0.4s" /> A black crow, on the garden wall. Caw! Caw! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Caw caw caw!

slides.title: Turquoise
slides.transcript: [warmly] Turquoise. <break time="0.4s" /> A turquoise peacock opens his tail. Kee-ow! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Kee-ow!

slides.title: Gold
slides.transcript: [warmly] Gold. <break time="0.4s" /> A gold lion, with a great big mane. Roar! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Roooar!

slides.title: Sand
slides.transcript: [warmly] Sand. <break time="0.4s" /> A sandy camel, walking in the desert. Hummph! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Hummph!

slides.title: Light Green
slides.transcript: [warmly] Light green. <break time="0.4s" /> A light green parrot, learning to talk. Hello! Hello! <break time="0.5s" /> [playfully] Hello, hello!

slides.title: Rainbow
slides.transcript: [warmly] All the colours. <break time="0.4s" /> Red, yellow, blue, green, orange, purple, pink, brown, grey, <break time="0.3s" /> white, black, turquoise, gold, sand and light green. All of them together. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Goodnight, Yusuf.
